name: DEADLIGHT MESH BROADCAST
description: One of the oldest active pirate mesh networks in Meridian 88, operating through a rotating constellation of encrypted relay nodes distributed across abandoned infrastructure in the Shelf and outer Tier 2 zones. Deadlight Mesh broadcasts a continuous feed of banned documentaries, unlicensed music, underground neural-feed content, and live transmissions from Shelf events that licensed networks refuse to cover. Its technical operators are unknown; its editorial voice is consistent and uncompromising.
cultural_impact: Became a symbol of information resistance across the lower tiers, with its signal-lock tone used as a cultural shorthand for defiance of corponation media control.
story_hooks: Someone has begun feeding Deadlight Mesh with content that appears to originate from inside Vantablack's own production archives — material that was never supposed to leave the building.
A Tier 3 professional who has been secretly relaying Deadlight Mesh signals through her apartment's BCI node is compromised when Axiom Security traces an unusual transmission pattern to her building.
Deadlight Mesh broadcasts a live feed of an event that, according to every licensed network, is not happening — and the footage is unambiguously real.
